videos.title: It Has Only Happened Twice Before, and Both Were March 2020
videos.description:
The VIX looks like it is pushing higher this week, and part of that is an artifact. It is a calendar day calculation, so Thanksgiving, the half session and the weekend get pulled out, four days gone, and the number comes back higher on Monday. Cem Karsan also explains why dealers warehousing massive short stock into the largest expiration yet makes a fast decline unlikely, and where he wants to own volatility instead. Ilya Spivak has been short since early October.
